title: Warm Pillowy Ukrainian Brussels Sprouts Braise
description: A cozy Ukrainian dish featuring fermented Brussels sprouts in a rich braise, cooked to perfection on a salt block. This nut-free-friendly recipe is perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Preheat the salt block in the oven at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 30 minutes.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the Brussels sprouts, sauerkraut, caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Remove the salt block from the oven and carefully place the skillet on top of it.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and braise the mixture for 20 minutes, or until the Brussels sprouts are tender.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the Warm Pillowy Ukrainian Brussels Sprouts Braise hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
